headline: Hunter Biden vs. Jared Kushner foreign money — swamp families trade accusations over $225K art access-peddling vs. $6B Gulf fund
context_chunks: Hunter Biden's art dealer handled over $225,000 in sales to a Democratic donor with foreign business ties, according to House Oversight records released Tuesday.
Jared Kushner's Affinity Partners received a $2 billion investment from a Saudi fund six months after leaving the White House, with subsequent tranches bringing the total to roughly $6 billion.
Both cases have become flashpoints in 2026 midterm campaign messaging, with neither family facing criminal charges as of the report date.

headline: Democrats suddenly care about presidential 'fitness' — Bill Clinton double standards under fresh scrutiny
context_chunks: Several Senate Democrats who voted against removing Bill Clinton in 1998 are now publicly backing age-related fitness disclosures for the 2028 presidential field.
The pivot follows a wave of internal polling showing voters under 40 have moved sharply on the question of cognitive fitness for office.

headline: Graham Platner scandal — Maine Dems panic as Senate seat slides to GOP
context_chunks: Internal Maine Democratic Party polling obtained by The Hill shows Sen. Platner trailing his Republican challenger by 9 points, a 14-point swing from June.
The drop coincides with a revived mastectomy-scar tattoo controversy and new questions about past Reddit posts.
GOP outside spending in the race has tripled over the same period.
